title: Interpretable deep learning detects BRCA pathogenic variants from H&E breast cancer slides
summary: BiAMIL, a bi-directional self-attention multiple-instance learning model, predicted BRCA pathogenic variant status from H&E slides with AUC 0.819 in internal testing and 0.817 in a separate external test set. Attention-based analyses linked tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and tumor-cell morphology to BRCA status. The data are small (319 slides from 254 patients) with wide confidence intervals.
ai_technology: BiAMIL bi-directional self-attention multiple-instance learning model
organization: School of Medicine, Chongqing University, Chongqing, China; Chongqing University Cancer Hospital, Chongqing, China

evidence.tested: Internal and external test-set evaluation against genetic testing labels.
evidence.unknown: Performance in larger cohorts and whether it can replace or triage genetic testing; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep neural network predicted BRCA status from slide images and highlighted associated features.
